blend.note: the Vascones - a Basque Pyrenean mountain people, an old Iberian substrate under a Frankish/Carolingian feudal overlay (a Vasconia/Gascony march)

_note: Cross-family blend (Frankish + Iberian): the Vascones - a Basque mountain people of the high passes, an ancient Iberian stock under a Frankish feudal overlordship. Backbone = Iberian (classical family, realized in its Basque-Vasconian register: mendi/ibai/etxe/jaun); overlay = Frankish (germanic family, Merovan: the march-county feudal titles Markigravo/Gravo/Herizogo). civ = feudal (a mountain march). Seeds/shifts Lawful or Neutral. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Basque/Frankish registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Iberian primary, Frankish variant), never real gods.

phonology.palette: Basque-Vasconian backbone (the Iberian substrate realized in Basque: tx/tz, h, rr, -a article, k/g; no native f) with a Frankish overlay (-burg/-mark, the feudal -o offices); theophoric on the Iberian morphs (Caiandos-, Orlanno-) with Frankish variants (Giando-, Erlant-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC; rr/tz/tx; vowel-final frequent; the Frankish overlay adds -burg and dithematic march-names.

morphology.patronymic_form: Basque patronymic -ez / -enea (son of, of the house of); the etxe (house) names the lineage; the Frankish overlay adds -ing dynastic names for the march-lords.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|feature](stem) + element: Beltz-mendi (black-mountain), Haitz-uri (crag-town); the Frankish overlay yields -burg forts and -mark marches.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Pyrenean march: Basque jaun lordship under a Frankish feudal overlay - the errege over jaunak, with Frankish margraves and counts on the marches)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Basque-Vasconian ladder, ascending, with a Frankish feudal overlay on the marches. Jauntxo (petty-lord) barony; Markigravo (Frankish margrave) march, over a Marka; Gravo (Frankish count) county, over a Konderri; Herizogo (Frankish duke) duchy; Jaun Nagusi (Basque great-lord) principality; Errege (king) kingdom; Errege Nagusi (high-king) over the realm. The Frankish crown often claims overlordship of the march. (Rank titles are the real Basque/Frankish register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: personal + etxe (house-name) or -ez patronymic; the march-lords add a Frankish -ing dynastic name; mountain/animal bynames.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Basque mountain-folk keep etxe house-names; the Frankish-overlay march-lords carry dithematic dynastic names.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Basque-Iberian devotional names on the morphed stems (Mael-/Gilla- equivalents); the Frankish-overlay clergy a Latinate register: e.g. Caiando-ren, Wih-Giando.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon (Iberian primary, from the Cantabran register; Frankish variant, from family_germanic reflexes), never real Basque/Frankish gods. Vascani seeds/shifts Lawful or Neutral; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). A mountain religion: the harrespil (stone-circle) and the sacred oak (haritz) keep the old rite, the Frankish-overlay munster the new; the enduring mountain (Caiandos) is foremost.
religion.the_one: Aiternos (< Aeternus; Frankish variant Aiterno) - the high maker, the sky over the peaks; revered when Lawful, set aside when Neutral

sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Caiandos (Frk. Giando) - the enduring mountain, foremost of the Vascani powers; Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Orlanno (Frk. Erlant) - the iron-oath (and the famed Basque iron); Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Rialta (Frk. Rialda) - the mother, the hearth; Neutral-honored
sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Maraxos (Frk. Marach) - the war-fire; Chaotic power, demonized

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: revere the One (Aiternos) and the Lawful powers (Caiandos the mountain, Orlanno the iron-oath, Numench), demonize the Chaotic powers
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent; foreground the asaba (ancestral dead), the mountain- and oak-spirits, and the harrespil rites

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (the Chaotic powers, when Lawful) take dread epithets: Maraxus -> Maraxos the Burning; Vacidus -> Bacaid the Unmaker; Lusanto -> Losand the Hoard-Worm.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Harrespil (stone-circle) and Nemeton (oak-grove) of [power], and the Frankish Munstar: 'the Harrespil of Caiandos', 'the Munstar of Giando'.
religion.saints_pattern: ancestral hillfort-heroes of the etxe and the mountain, plus Frankish-overlay royal saints (Wih [name]), honored at the harrespil and the burial-cairn.

holy_symbol_motifs.Caiandos: a grey peak above crossed oak
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlanno: a Basque iron-cross (lauburu) over an oath-ring

banks_patterns.ships: (a mountain people) river-craft and the iron-laden mule-trains: 'the Iron Mule', 'the Grey Peak', 'Wave of the Itsaso'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [etxe] gudari-band / the march lances: 'the Iron Gudariak', 'the Pass-Wardens'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: ruined gazteluak and old harrespil-circles in the high passes: 'the Gaztelu of [name]', 'the Stone-Ring of [mendi]'
